test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 13 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the INCORRECT statement with respect to the properties of a circle.

options.text: Two tangents drawn at the end of the diameter of a circle are parallel.
The radius drawn perpendicular to a chord bisects the chord.
The diameter of a circle is the longest chord of a circle.
The perpendicular distance from the centre of a circle increases when the length of a chord increases.

solution:
Calculation:

The first three statements are correct.

But the last statement is incorrect. Because the perpendicular distance from the centre of the circle decreases when the length of the chord increases.

**∴ Option 4 is the incorrect statement with respect to the properties of a circle.**
